verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator is a credential and authentication app, so issuing scoped credentials for automated agents is a fair question, as some credential managers offer service accounts. The evidence only covers human-facing sign-in: OTP codes, push approvals, passkeys, Verified IDs and password autofill. Nothing shows it can issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.
